source: You will start by standing in the living room area. Turn around and take one step in front of the staircase. To the right of the staircase you will see an opening and you will also see from here another staircase leading down. Walk towards that staircase. Make your way down the stairs. Once you're in front of the bench turn to your right and take one step there. Turn right once again and you will see a hallway. Walk down this hallway. Turn right and you will see an opening. Walk towards this opening. You will see it is a lounge room. There will be two arm chairs on the left corner of this room. Walk towards those chairs. It's a weirdly patterned chairs. There are plants in between the chairs and also behind one of the chairs. Once you've facing these chairs then you're done.
